game_intro_desc1: QingFeng is a visual novel game engine and cross-platform game launcher built with libGDX. The project adopts a standardized file structure and a JSON-driven resource system, organizing game content in a clear, consistent format to provide creators with a unified and stable runtime environment.
game_intro_desc2: QingFeng natively supports 15 interface languages: 简体中文, 繁體中文 (Taiwan/Hong Kong), English (US/UK), Español (España/México), Français (France/Canada), Português (Brasil/Portugal), Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, along with a switchable theme system to suit users' individual preferences. It runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android, covering both desktop and mobile use cases.
game_intro_desc3: QingFeng features a comprehensive resource pack management system, supporting the import and switching of language packs, theme packs, game language packs, and game theme packs, helping creators extend game content flexibly. Version checking and one-click resource repair ensure that game resources remain complete and usable at all times.
game_intro_desc4: Games and resource packs use dedicated file formats (.qfg, .qfl, .qft, .qfgl, .qfgt), registered across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android, so you can load and run them directly with a double-click. Visual editors, 2D maps, and video playback are on the roadmap, opening up more possibilities for creators.
